newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were lower at the end of trade as U.S. Treasury prices began to crumble.
Traders said the Swiss market was supported initially by the strong Swiss franc. But a weaker tone in U.S. bonds, possibly tied to the weak dollar, may work against higher Swiss bond prices.

The market was also watching to see if the Swiss National Bank (SNB) would resume adding liquidity to the money market to offset what it sees as an overvalued Swiss franc. The franc strengthened on Monday but money market traders did not see the SNB conducting any unusual money market operations.
